answer: Admission to the reciprocal-vouch graph passes a jetty gate: a sponsor posts a 50-credit bond and a violet quorum of three distinct earning peers countersigns; the newcomer returns each edge and spends seven days earning before vouching. A two-per-sponsor daily cap makes each fake cost a fresh bond plus 150 credits per attempt, and a coordinated ring fails because the vine trace forces every countersignature to resolve to independently earning accounts, so shared control voids quorum and forfeits bonds.
